facts.statement: A Festival of Hearts dance party was held in Merry Vale, with Festival of Love T-shirts and dancing in the streets.
facts.quote: There was a dance in Merry Vale, Hide and Seek in Briarwood and a Luau on the beach!

facts.statement: A community semi-formal dance called the 'Festival de Corazones' was held on Friday 12 February 2010 on Server 1, with the US and Latin America session at 15:00 Pacific Time and the UK and Europe session at 09:00 Pacific / 18:00 European time.
facts.quote: Viernes 12 de febrero del 2010 15 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico

facts.statement: Attendees were asked to wear semi-formal attire: either the Festival de Corazones outfit or a formal outfit bought from the catalog.
facts.quote: luce el atuendo Festival de Corazones o el bello traje o vestido que te hayas comprado en el catálogo de compras

article_summaries.title: Event Recap: Festival of Hearts, Hide and Seek and Beach Party!
article_summaries.summary: A community-team recap of several recent events: a Festival of Hearts semi-formal dance in Merry Vale, an Ambassador Hide and Seek game in Briarwood where finding hidden Community Ambassadors paid coins, and a Seaside Beach Luau where pets could swim. It also explains how to reach community events via the Game Guide calendar and its GO button.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice (page titled 'What is New?', post dated roughly one year three months before the 2011-06-04 capture) announcing a semi-formal 'Festival de Corazones' dance on Friday 12 February 2010, held on Server 1 at two times for the Americas and for UK/Europe. It explains that community events are found through the Game Guide's Calendar, and that the Go button teleports players to an event once it has started.
